description: Vegan Richa is a popular food blog and cookbook brand offering wildly flavorful and inventive plant-based recipes inspired by Indian cuisine. Founded by Richa, it features recipes that are gluten-free, soy-free, nut-free, and oil-free options. The blog covers Indian vegan recipes, Instant Pot meals, breakfast, lunch, dinner, desserts, holiday recipes, and more. Vegan Richa has published three cookbooks: Vegan Richa's Instant Pot Cookbook (150 recipes from Indian cuisine and beyond), Vegan Richa's Indian Kitchen (often named Best Vegan Indian Cookbook), and Vegan Richa's Everyday Kitchen (easy meals, sauces, curries, stews, burgers, pizzas, casseroles, cakes). The site includes recipe videos, Indian pantry resources, dal/lentil guides, and vegan substitution resources.
